description: Publishes an existing page: builds the rendered app on the Webcake build host (POST <buildBase>/render/build; https://build.webcake.io in production, overridable with WEBCAKE_BUILD_BASE / x-webcake-build-base) and then creates or updates the published record that public serving reads. With custom_domain (already pointed at Webcake) the page is served at that domain; when omitted, the page's currently attached domain is reused; with no domain, or custom_domain:'', only the preview link (<previewBase>/preview/<page_id>) is returned, and it renders for about 10 minutes after the publish. Without a build host, or if the build fails, it falls back to a source-only publish that saves a version but serves nothing, and returns a warning. dry_run defaults to true and makes no network calls; dry_run:false builds and publishes. Requires Webcake credentials.

custom_domain.description: Optional custom domain to serve the page at (e.g. 'shop.example.com' — must already point at Webcake). Use it EXACTLY as the account lists it: 'www.example.com' and 'example.com' are DIFFERENT domain records — a www/non-www mismatch is corrected to the stored form, and a domain the account never added is refused (nothing published). OMIT to reuse the page's CURRENTLY-ATTACHED domain (so republishing keeps it live at the same URL, like the editor's publish modal); if the page has none it publishes domain-less (preview-host URL). Pass an empty string '' to force a domain-less publish even when the page has a domain.

custom_path.description: Optional path under the custom domain (e.g. 'sale').

dry_run.description: Default TRUE — preview the request without sending. Does NOT call the build host. Set false to actually publish (build + publish).

page_id.description: The page id to publish (must be owned by the account).

name: publish_page
